ns2:course.label: History of American Indian Education
ns2:course.description: Students will study various efforts to "civilize" American Indians through US government initiatives and religious churches, as well as educational models developed by tribal entities following passage of the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act of 1975. Same as EPOL 404. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
